lines.trans: There was an older sister figure I liked since my college days.
She is a producer in the variety department.
After joining the company, I found out she already has a boyfriend.
And that male producer has a suspicious relationship with another female producer.
I saw them by chance, and after work they went into the same home.
If I just let it slide, the two of them seem so shameless,
I did not know what to do, so I did not even want to go to work.
Did I not tell you never to appear in my sight?
I told you, let's finish him off!
Ugh, I really hate going to work.

있다.gloss: to exist, to have, to stay

meanings.en: to exist, to be (in a place)
meanings.note: Opposite of 없다.
Marks the possessed item with 이/가.

examples.trans: Do you have time?
Nobody is at home.

related.gloss: to not exist, to not have

meanings.en: older sister; older female friend or senior
meanings.note: Used by a younger male speaker.

examples.trans: I have one older sister.
Nuna, do you have time today?

meanings.note: refers to something known to both speakers or near the listener

examples.trans: That movie was really fun.
What is that person's name?

meanings.note: Division of a television network that produces variety and entertainment shows.

examples.trans: He works in the variety department at a broadcasting station.
Variety department PDs are always busy.

meanings.note: Hangul spelling of the English abbreviation PD, widely used in Korean broadcasting.

examples.trans: Who is the PD in charge of the new program?

examples.text: 그녀는 예능 피디가 되기 위해 시험을 준비했다.
examples.trans: She prepared for the exam to become a variety PD.
Did you hear about this joining the company?
I was busy today because of joining the company.

meanings.en: to do, to perform, to hold
meanings.note: Core verb; also combines with nouns to form verbs.

examples.trans: What are you doing right now?
We are holding a meeting today.

보다.gloss: to see, to watch; to take (an exam)

meanings.en: to see, to look at, to watch
meanings.note: Primary meaning.
Idiomatic in 시험을 보다.

examples.trans: I watched a movie on the weekend.
I took the driver's license exam.
Did you hear about this that person?
I was busy today because of that person.
The bus has already left.
I already heard that news.

meanings.en: to date; to go out with (romantically)
to make friends; to associate with

examples.trans: Since when have those two been dating?
I want to make many new friends.

related.gloss: to date; to be in a relationship

examples.trans: Did you hear about this man?
I was busy today because of man.

meanings.note: Used when repeating an action.

examples.trans: See you again!
It is raining again.

meanings.note: 르-irregular adjective; conjugates as 달라요 in polite present.
In its adnominal form 다른, modifies a following noun to mean 'other' or 'another'.

examples.trans: Do you have any other questions?
Our thoughts are different from each other.
Did you hear about this female?
I was busy today because of female.
It really is suspicious compared to what I thought.
Especially today, it is suspicious and nice.
Did you hear about this relationship?
I was busy today because of relationship.

meanings.note: Bound noun often contracted to 거 in everyday speech.

examples.trans: This is my bag.
Because I think I'm late.
I understand well (by chance).
Today is a (by chance) busy day.
Let's after leaving work together today.

examples.trans: one person
one hour

meanings.note: Softens a statement or downplays a motive.

examples.trans: I just asked out of curiosity.

meanings.note: native Korean numeral; 둘이 means 'the two of them'

examples.trans: The two of us work together.
Two coffees, please.

meanings.note: Used colloquially for positive or negative emphasis.
Original sense of exceeding a limit.

examples.trans: The weather is so nice today.
Don't worry too much.
The atmosphere today is really shameless, detestable.
That person always looks shameless, detestable.
I want to what to do right now.
How about trying to what to do together tomorrow?

좋다.gloss: to be good, to be nice

examples.trans: I feel really good today.
It's nice to take a walk in the morning.

meanings.en: to not know, to be unaware of
meanings.note: 르-irregular verb: stem 모르- + -아요/-았어요 → 몰라요 / 몰랐어요.

examples.trans: I don't know well either.
I didn't realize time was passing.
My office is close to home.
I go to work at the office at 9 a.m.

meanings.note: Basic verb of motion. With the respectful ending -세요 in 안녕히 가세요, it forms the polite farewell 'Goodbye!'. RR: gada.

examples.trans: I am going home.
Go safely!

meanings.note: Descriptive verb (adjective); the thing disliked takes the subject marker 이/가.

examples.trans: I really dislike rainy days.
You hate waking up early in the morning, right?

meanings.note: noun situation

examples.trans: Situation is good.
Situation is bad.
Do you have time today?
Where are you going?

meanings.note: Used only with close friends, younger people, or children
Plain first-person singular pronoun used with friends, younger people, or subordinates; contracts to 난 with -는 and becomes 내가 before -가.

examples.trans: I'm going to stay home today.
I'll go first.

meanings.note: noun eye

examples.trans: Eye hurts.
Eyes are big.
I want to catch sight right now.
How about trying to catch sight together tomorrow?

meanings.note: Auxiliary verb used after -지 to tell someone not to do something. Ending with -고 (말고) gives a brisk, trailing command. RR: malda.

examples.trans: Please do not worry.
Do not be late, and come early.

그러다.gloss: to say so; to do so

meanings.en: to say so; to speak like that
meanings.note: contracted from 그러하다; often follows quoted speech

meanings.en: to do so; to act like that

examples.trans: Who said that?

meanings.note: Expresses sudden realization, surprise, or hesitation.

examples.trans: Ah, yes.

meanings.note: Used in standard farewells 안녕히 계세요 and 안녕히 가세요.

examples.trans: Goodbye! (to someone staying)
Goodbye! (to someone leaving)

meanings.note: Honorific equivalent of 있다; used in 안녕히 계세요 ('goodbye' to someone staying).

examples.trans: Goodbye! (to someone staying)
